positions.title: Distinguished Engineer
positions.description:
• Principal engineer for Core Filesystem, Search, Storage and distributed databases.
• Led the filesystem search performance improvement from 10 sec to 2sec over 10s of billions of files.
• Implemented distributed event bus between public and private cloud with guaranteed delivery leading to more decoupled apps
• Made Content and metadata indexing near real time, increased fault tolerance and reduced no of required nodes by 150% as a side effect of new architecture. 
• Designed and led the development of automatic expired trial deletion touching all services of the architecture
• Led the zero downtime migration of Two Factor Authentication provider to Authy for entire customer base 
• Implemented Mid-week deployment leading to the reduction in operations team pain of doing weekend deployments leading to lesser burnouts.
* Tech Lead for design of various life sciences projects like Part11 compliant review-approve workflows, quality docs and workflow templates 

Blog posts about work done at Egnyte  
• http://highscalability.com/blog/2016/2/15/egnyte-architecture-lessons-learned-in-building-and-scaling.html
• https://www.elastic.co/blog/scaling-file-system-search-with-elasticsearch-at-egnyte
• https://theelasticast.com/episodes/0003-egnyte/
• https://www.egnyte.com/blog/author/kalpesh-patel/

positions.title: Sr.  Engineering Manager
positions.description:
• Principal engineer for Core Filesystem, Search, Storage and distributed databases.
• Took initiative to create dedicated Infrastructure team responsible for core Egnyte  services
• Architected and Implemented HA for Tomcat Apps that lead to 60% reduction in no of tomcat instances and direct SLA improvement.
• Broke monolith into further functional services to achieve Y axis on scale cube
• Organized 2 Hackathons at Egnyte with more than 10 teams participating in each of them. https://www.egnyte.com/blog/2015/09/hackathon-at-egnyte/ and https://www.egnyte.com/blog/2015/12/why-breaking-free-from-the-routine-matters/
• Building a search backbone indexing multiple Petabytes of data at Egnyte using Elasticsearch and GCE https://www.egnyte.com/blog/2015/06/scaling-elasticsearch-at-egnyte/

positions.title: Architect
positions.description:
• One of the founding engineers 
• Principal engineer for Core Filesystem, Search, Storage and distributed databases.
• SRE for many backend services and responsible for site's uptime while meeting month over month growth.
• Implemented Swimlanes and Pods to increase SLA and isolating the thundering herd impact area. 
• Rewrote distributed filesystem backend that scales horizontally by adding more MySQL shards. It's growing billions of rows every year and scaling seamlessly.
• Implemented event store backbone for realtime eventual consistent event based sync of distributed filesystem.

positions.title: Technical Product Manager
positions.description:
Acquired by BlueYonder

• One of the implementors in One Network Platform team creating SDK framework/Apis to be used by Application teams.
• Implemented and maintained core modules like Dataset2App, P2PI, Cache
• Ensured Scalability of various releases of Logistics Network.
• Did PSR(Performance, Scalability and Reliability)  for various products at One Network using LoadRunner and various Java/Oracle profiling tools.
• Architected and Implemented a Data Warehouse for One Network Distributed Transaction Backbone.
• Developed the Star schema and an NetChange ETL/Reverse ETL framework to port data between OLTP and OLAP system.
• Used Java, J2EE, Oracle, Jboss, Tomcat, eclipse, apache, loadrunner, xml, html, Oracle ADDM, postgress, python, jprofiler to develop and maintain enterprise applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked for a Multi Party Network Supply chain solution called iSupply.

• Developed a small PDF Reports generation  framework using JasperReports/Java/J2EE.
• Developed Admin ui using Struts + Hibernate for Agent management.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Software Engineer for Supply demand match module. Valdero is the Air Traffic Control System of the extended Supply Chain.

Responsibilities: 
• 	Implementing Supply Demand Match Algorithm and developing the end-to-end solution from Front-end to Back-end for it. Technologies used are Struts/XMLC/Barracuda/EJB/JDBC/JavaScript.
• 	Doing performance optimization of algorithm implementation to handle loads of millions of records.
• 	Implementation of Replenishment module from front-end to back-end.
• 	Breaking and distributing tasks to the offshore team.
• 	Developing What-if Scenarios based on underlying Data warehouse’s multi-dimensional schema.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Major Responsibilities: 
• 	Analysis, Design and implementation of various consulting projects running in the company.
• 	Interacting with clients in USA and finalizing the Implementation details.
• 	Taking Technical interviews on J2EE for the recruitment in the company.
• 	Taking technical seminars on J2EE topics.

patents.title: Event-Based User State Synchronization in a Local Cloud of a Cloud Storage System
patents.description: The invention facilitates centralized control of user definitions, near real-time event delivery to local cloud storage systems, and separation of authentication processes from customers' active directory services.

patents.title: System and method of implementing an object storage infrastructure for cloud-based services
patents.description: A method for storing objects in an object storage system includes the steps of establishing a network connection with a client over an inter-network, receiving an upload request indicating an object to be uploaded by the client, selecting at least two storage nodes on which the object will be stored, receiving the object from the client via the network connection, and streaming the object to each of the selected storage nodes such that the object is stored on each of the selected storage nodes. The method can also include writing an object record associating the object and the selected storage nodes to a shard of an object database and generating a Universally Unique Identifier (UUID). The UUID indicates the shard and the object ID of the object record, such that the object record can be quickly retrieved. Object storage infrastructures are also disclosed.
